title: Normalized realization pullback comparison data
statement: For the integral constructible complete and raw rational categories, define the normalized scalar pullback data for the realization pullback comparison: separated finite-type schemes over a field with explicit finiteness and invertibility hypotheses; actual integral and rational coefficient maps, ordinary and strict completed integral restrictions, unit-normalized scalar comparisons, and their identity, composition and fraction equations. The existence proposition retains the canonical completed compositor normalization and uniqueness as well as raw rational coherence. This is precisely the original data of that lemma, with no mathematical change.
